## Zhu Xi on knowledge

Zhu Xi (1130–1200) approaches knowledge within Neo-Confucianism. Li is the coherent pattern in all things; qi individuates and can obscure nature. Human nature is originally good as principle; cultivation clears turbid qi through investigation of things (gewu) and reverence. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets knowledge most directly—useful for searches such as “zhu xi quotes on knowledge.”
